'''Enfeeble''' is a level 73 [[Magic]] [[spell]]. When cast on an opponent, their [[Strength]] level is reduced by 10%. Casting Enfeeble grants 83 Magic experience and requires 1 [[Soul rune|Soul]], 8 [[Earth rune|Earth]], and 8 [[Water rune]]s to be cast. The spell can only be cast if the opponent's stats haven't already been lowered, meaning you cannot stack the 10% Strength reduction with multiple spells in a row.
